fusions.name: Cleaving Maw
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 18 damage and eats every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one eaten. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Windrow Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps edged wings in a full circle, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hooked Wing-Edges
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Mown Rows
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
